verdict.rationale: Authy's documented API and SDK let services send and verify 2FA tokens for their own users. The evidence shows no CLI or API through which an agent can read an end user's current TOTP codes. Per the probe, the Authy API is also closed to new customers and slated for deprecation. Community accounts of dumping tokens through debug-mode desktop apps or a deprecated Chrome extension are user-side workarounds, not a product capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can fetch a current TOTP code programmatically — via CLI or API — to complete a 2FA login inside an automated workflow
